rasterization.coverage: Union of every round-capped polyline segment at radius 1 and the filled cursor polygon. Never connect the two polylines.
rasterization.polygonRule: Point-in-polygon, nonzero or even-odd (this simple polygon has no self intersection). Include boundary points.
rasterization.supersampling: Use existing antialiasing or at least 4x4 coverage samples. Scale coordinates and stroke together.
rasterization.alpha: Transparent outside the union. White RGB for Android notification foreground; black RGB for macOS template tray. No colored field or red detail inside the monochrome asset.
rasterization.launcherPlacement: White union on the established #244C6A field. This master has larger bounds than ribbon D: check platform safe zones and apply a uniform centered inset when needed; do not clip or alter individual parts.
